title: Ventriloquist LLMs: Linear Alignment of Late-Stage Representations
abstract: arXiv:2603.18908v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Independently trained language models often learn compatible late-stage representations, despite differences in training objectives, architectures, and data modalities. We ask how far this compatibility extends: can a simple affine map let one model's hidden states be read directly by another model's output head? In this work, we learn affine transformations between the final hidden states of independent models and evaluate them across embedding classification, out-of-distribution detection, and autoregressive text generation. Across model pairs, we find that downstream performance is largely preserved under alignment, with linearly mapped source representations retaining both the decision boundaries and the confidence structure of a target model's classifier. translated_title: 腹语师大语言模型：后期表征的线性对齐
translated_abstract: 独立训练的语言模型尽管在训练目标、架构和数据模态上存在差异，却往往能学习到相互兼容的后期表征。我们探究这种兼容性能延伸到何种程度：一个简单的仿射映射能否让一个模型的隐藏状态被另一个模型的输出头直接读取？在本工作中，我们学习独立模型最终隐藏状态之间的仿射变换，并在嵌入分类、分布外检测和自回归文本生成任务上对其进行评估。在各个模型对中，我们发现对齐后的下游性能在很大程度上得以保留，线性映射后的源表征同时保留了目标模型分类器的决策边界和置信度结构。此外，我们首次展示线性对齐有时能够实现跨独立训练模型的文本生成，通过解码一个模型的隐藏状态……
tldr: 独立训练的大语言模型的后期隐藏状态可以通过简单的仿射映射实现相互对齐，使一个模型的表征能被另一个模型的输出头直接读取，下游性能基本保留，甚至首次实现了跨模型的文本生成。
en_tdlr: Late-stage hidden states of independently trained LLMs can be aligned through simple affine maps, allowing one model's representations to be read directly by another model's output head while largely preserving downstream performance and, for the first time, enabling cross-model text generation.
